episodes.title: Carry On
episodes.summary: When nurse practitioner Mel moves to a remote town in northern California looking for a new life, she's startled by the welcome she receives.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: After finding an abandoned baby on Doc Mullins's doorstep, Mel and her boss argue over whether to call Social Services or find the newborn's mother.

episodes.title: ... and Found
episodes.summary: Mel considers being a temporary foster parent to Chloe while grappling with her own grief. Jack works to convince her to stay in Virgin River.

episodes.title: A Wounded Heart
episodes.summary: Hope's health scare prompts a difficult conversation with Doc. Charmaine asks Mel uncomfortable questions. Paige keeps secrets.

episodes.title: Under Fire
episodes.summary: Under pressure, Mel and Jack respond to a medical emergency on a remote illegal pot farm. Charmaine and Hope exchange words.

episodes.title: Let's Mingle
episodes.summary: Mel gets a surprise visitor just in time for the town's big dance party. Jack continues to suffer flashbacks from his time in the military.

episodes.title: If Truth Be Told
episodes.summary: Preacher happens upon a secret. Mel's memories threaten to overwhelm her. Jack has a sincere talk with Charmaine about their relationship.

episodes.title: Into the Light
episodes.summary: A storm causes a town power outage and everybody gets together at Jack's bar. Mel grapples with her revelation. Preacher investigates Paige.

episodes.title: Everybody Has a Secret
episodes.summary: Hope urges Jack to read Charmaine's letter. Preacher confronts Paige with his new knowledge. Mel and Doc work together on a pressing case.

episodes.title: Unexpected Endings
episodes.summary: Charmaine tells a stunned Jack to make a decision while Mel is left reeling and Hope is filled with guilt. Meanwhile, Paige opens up to Preacher.

episodes.title: New Beginnings
episodes.summary: Jack asks Mel for help when Charmaine experiences a complication in her pregnancy. Hope insists that Doc keep their relationship a secret.

episodes.title: Taken by Surprise
episodes.summary: Despite Mel's efforts, Charmaine's stay at Hope's house gets off to a rocky start. A situation involving Paige's past intensifies unexpectedly.

episodes.title: The Morning After
episodes.summary: Mel endeavors to help an uncooperative Charmaine get hydrated while thinking about what transpired with Jack. Calvin offers Brady a new job.

episodes.title: Rumor Has It
episodes.summary: The town attends the annual picnic where residents engage in friendly competition, romantic tiffs and —as far as Mel is concerned — too much gossip

episodes.title: Can't Let Go
episodes.summary: Jack's war memories haunt him when he reunites with his Marine friends. Mel struggles to handle conflict with her sister-in-law.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: Mel grapples with how to honor Mark ahead of the anniversary of his death. Jack's stress leads him to bad decisions. Hope apologizes with pie.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: When police find a body in the woods, Preacher worries about the implications. Charmaine and Jack work on a birth plan with Mel.

episodes.title: Blindspots
episodes.summary: While Jack helps Mike zero in on Calvin, Mel and Doc investigate a mysterious outbreak that could be related to food poisoning. Hope learns a secret.

episodes.title: Hazards Ahead
episodes.summary: Mel searches desperately for Jack, who has stumbled upon disturbing news. Jamie makes Preacher an enticing job offer. Hope questions Doc's loyalty.

episodes.title: Blown Away
episodes.summary: Mel tracks down Brady to find out more about Spencer. Hope answers Doc's question. Preacher makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke...
episodes.summary: Mel attempts to avoid celebrating her birthday while remembering the past. Doc confirms his troubling diagnosis and begins looking for his replacement.

episodes.title: Sticky Feet
episodes.summary: Ricky and Lizzie struggle to find privacy. Doc worries about Hope, who may be stuck in a hurricane. Mel offers Jack an enticing invitation.

episodes.title: Spare Parts and Broken Hearts
episodes.summary: Lily divulges a devastating secret to Mel. Brie gets to know Brady better and admits something to Jack. Lizzie's ex surprises her.

episodes.title: Take My Breath Away
episodes.summary: Doc and Mel help Christopher and Preacher with a medical emergency. After an angry confrontation, Jack focuses his energy on a romantic gesture.

episodes.title: Kindling
episodes.summary: Mel is taken aback by Doc's news after they interview a new doctor. To Jack's chagrin, Todd makes a bold request. Lilly makes a difficult revelation.

episodes.title: Jack and Jill
episodes.summary: Jack and Mel argue about their relationship and their future while competing in the Lumberjack Games. Brie opens up about her painful breakup.

episodes.title: Split
episodes.summary: Jack meets with a custody attorney and his stress begins to overwhelm him. Brady gets brought in for questioning. Muriel offers Doc advice.

episodes.title: Life and Death
episodes.summary: Heartbroken, Mel heads to LA to support Joey at her divorce hearing. More of Jack's memories return. Lily asks her friends to care for her children.

episodes.title: The Sun Also Rises
episodes.summary: The town says goodbye to a dear friend. Brie suffers a loss of her own. Mel and Jack discuss what should happen with their relationship.

episodes.title: A Wedding, No Funeral and a Baby
episodes.summary: Jack makes a momentous decision as Mel grapples with how to share surprising news. Doc is plagued with concern. Preacher meets with Paige's friend.

episodes.title: Be My Baby
episodes.summary: Mel seeks medical care, with a nervous Jack by her side. Hope's confusion puts Doc in a tough position. A new doctor joins the practice.

episodes.title: Father Knows Best...?
episodes.summary: Jack and Brie's father causes friction when he comes into town. An incident at work affects Mel. Doc gets to know his unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Grilled
episodes.summary: Mel plans a dinner for Cameron to meet Jack, but plans go awry. Connie warns Lizzie to be careful with Denny. Preacher befriends his aikido teacher.

episodes.title: Serious As A...
episodes.summary: Hope's concussive symptoms continue, frustrating both her and Doc. Meanwhile, Mel asks Preacher to help her surprise a stubborn Jack.

episodes.title: Mayday
episodes.summary: After Hope and friends sew the costumes, Lizzie and Ricky rehearse for the Renaissance Fair. Brie and Mike team up to investigate who paid Brady's bond.

episodes.title: All's Faire...
episodes.summary: The Renaissance Fair kicks off. Mel worries about Jack after a familiar face triggers painful memories. Denny watches Lizzie and Ricky perform.

episodes.title: Otherwise Engaged
episodes.summary: Joey arrives with some shocking news that has Mel questioning her sister's judgment. Jack brainstorms a new revenue stream.

episodes.title: Talk to Me
episodes.summary: Mel plans a surprise for Joey but is distracted by her concern for Jack. Lizzie struggles with telling Doc what she saw in Denny's drawer.

episodes.title: Bombshells
episodes.summary: Mel deals with the aftermath of Jack's disappearance while also getting troubling news from Stacie. Mike and Brie continue their search for Calvin.

episodes.title: Fire and Rain
episodes.summary: Charmaine asks Jack for support at the baby shower. Mel has a tough conversation with Cassandra. Preacher worries about Christopher after their call.

episodes.title: Once Again
episodes.summary: Vernon and Hope argue about seeking in-home care, Mel confronts Cameron about his odd behavior, and Jack gets his glamping Airstream up and running.

episodes.title: The Long Goodbye
episodes.summary: Mel and Jack finally receive the results they've been waiting on. Lizzie organizes a send-off for Ricky before speaking to Denny about his secret.

episodes.title: A Second Chance
episodes.summary: Mel makes a tough decision. Jack draws a potential business investor. Preacher and Paige wonder if they're on the same page. A council meeting stuns Hope.

episodes.title: Songbird
episodes.summary: Doc and Cameron try to run the clinic together. Mel supports Ava through a personal dilemma. Jack confronts Charmaine. Brady seeks a second chance.

episodes.title: Calculated Risk
episodes.summary: Mel makes an exception for a former patient. Brie opens up to Brady. Preacher meets a charming firefighter. Jack goes mountain climbing with Denny.

episodes.title: Never Gonna Be the Same
episodes.summary: Doc confides in Denny. Hope's spa day takes a turn. A desperate Brady reaches out to Mike. On a camping trip, Mel and Jack learn more about each other.

episodes.title: Trial by Fire
episodes.summary: As danger closes in, Jack, Hope and other residents take action. A discovery puts Mel on edge. Brie sees a friendly face after a tense day in court.

episodes.title: Heroes Rise
episodes.summary: Mel and Jack race to bring Ava and Chloe to safety. As the crisis intensifies, Brady defies Preacher, while Hope proposes a plan to save Virgin River.

episodes.title: From the Ashes
episodes.summary: The devastation brings revelations and reconciliations as the community attempts to rebuild and lift each other up after the fires.

episodes.title: Full Moon
episodes.summary: After a girls' night, Mel struggles to let go of her fears. Kaia opens up to Preacher. Mike and Brady set aside their differences to nab a criminal.

episodes.title: Angel's Peak
episodes.summary: Mel and Jack explore other possibilities for their future. Brady follows Melissa and lands in an awkward position. Romance is in the air at the clinic.

episodes.title: Labor Day
episodes.summary: Tensions escalate as Brady, Jack and Mike get caught in the crosshairs of an illicit scheme. More surprises emerge for Mel, Denny and Preacher.

episodes.title: The More the Merrier
episodes.summary: As the holidays get underway, visiting relatives bring drama to town. Mel and Jack try to track down the author of the mysterious letters to her mother.

episodes.title: Father Christmas
episodes.summary: Shocking news and unexpected gifts are in store on Christmas Eve as couples and families come together despite their differences.

episodes.title: Hope Springs Eternal
episodes.summary: Mel wants to honor her mom at the wedding and asks for Everett's help. Brady and Lark celebrate his settlement. Preacher's trial begins with a twist.

episodes.title: The Broken Places
episodes.summary: Everett reveals the story of how he met Mel's mother. Preacher faces a life-changing choice. The sewing circle plays matchmaker for Muriel.

episodes.title: The Jury's Out
episodes.summary: A familiar face returns to town with surprising news. Preacher awaits his fate. Mel meets with Doc to discuss her new plan. Brady puts Lark on the spot.

episodes.title: Brothers & Sisters
episodes.summary: Old tensions and buried feelings emerge when Mel and Jack's pre-wedding parties get a little rowdy. Lizzie and Denny are uncertain about their future.

episodes.title: Love Story
episodes.summary: Mel and Jack's fathers meet for brunch, leaving Everett with second thoughts. Doc makes a heroic move. A routine prison visit raises Brie's suspicions.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: After Mel and Jack run into a paperwork glitch, Jack visits Mandy — and admits a past mistake. Kaia knows Brady's secret. An old nemesis makes threats.

episodes.title: I Climbed a Mountain and I Turned Around
episodes.summary: Everett takes Mel to a place that's dear to his heart. Brie confesses to Jack after helping Charmaine. Brady's past haunts him, and Mel lashes out at Doc.

episodes.title: Going Overboard
episodes.summary: Hope directs the rehearsal and helps Jack patch up a spat. Brie and Mike reach a major milestone. Everett sets out to finish his heartfelt gift.

episodes.title: Prelude to a Kiss
episodes.summary: Jack and Mel's wedding day gets off to an emotional start. The truth comes out about Doc and Everett. Hope's temper could cause trouble for Doc.

episodes.title: The Big Day
episodes.summary: While their guests wait, Mel confesses her fears to Jack. Brady has a rude awakening, Mike and Brie have a serious moment — and Doc gets stunning news.

episodes.title: The Afterglow
episodes.summary: Mel and Jack weigh Marley's offer — and debate honeymoon destinations — as they begin married life together. Brie and Mike confront their issues.

episodes.title: Beautiful Child
episodes.summary: Marley assesses Jack's fatherhood potential. Doc struggles to hold back when a patient seeks help. Brady searches for Lark — and his money.

episodes.title: The Match
episodes.summary: Mel, Jack and Marley examine more than the wares at a local flea market. Hope's campaign against Grace Valley hits a snag at a town hall meeting.

episodes.title: Pipe Dreams
episodes.summary: Jack and Mel prepare their unfinished home for a visit from a social worker. Brie does Brady a friendly favor. Doc takes a swing at something new.

episodes.title: Always Anywhere Forever
episodes.summary: Mel makes an unexpectedly dangerous house call. The sewing circle shares their concerns with Kaia. Hope and Doc get high on memories of young love.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.summary: An abrupt arrival threatens to upend Mel and Jack's plans. Kaia and Brady team up to tackle a wildfire. Preacher makes an ambitious proposal.

episodes.title: It Takes A Village
episodes.summary: Doc faces off with Dr. Hayes at a pivotal medical board hearing. A baby shower pushes Lizzie to her breaking point. Clay opens up about his past.

episodes.title: Back In The Saddle
episodes.summary: Clay tries to buck his troubles by entering a high-stakes rodeo competition. Brie tracks an unlikely new lead in the search for Charmaine.

episodes.title: La Luna De Miel
episodes.summary: Eager to escape their worries, Mel and Jack embark on their honeymoon, where a freewheeling day trip takes a surprising turn.

episodes.title: David and Goliath
episodes.summary: The town gathers for a festive Founder's Day, where Hope stages a last-ditch effort to preserve Virgin River. Mel and Jack receive life-changing news.
